_note: Congress.gov screen for NEW bills (tracked bills are always watched). It only decides what gets FETCHED, never what is published. precise_terms: frontier wording, a candidate at once. title_terms: a wide net (AI, compute, chips, security and threat wording, because a frontier bill's official title may have no AI word at all, e.g. 'Collaboration on Adversarial Threats and Security Risks Act'); these titles go to the AI intent check (grabber/intent.mjs), which drops only a confident 'no'. Recall-first: catching extra bills costs a few requests, missing one is not acceptable. Proved by grabber/recall-congress.mjs against every federal bill on the site. Finalised 13 Oct 2026.

federal_register._note: The Federal Register Grabber keeps its own phrase search and screen (unchanged).
